query: Review this skill against our house standards — does its front-matter follow our conventions?
expected_behavior: Should read skill-conventions.md READ-ONLY and produce a gap report for the target skill.

query: Revisa este skill contra nuestros estándares de la casa: la descripción y el allowed-tools.
expected_behavior: Should check the skill's front-matter against the house skill-conventions canon.

query: Check whether the new audit skill follows our skill patterns and tell me the gaps.
expected_behavior: Should produce a conventions gap report against skill-conventions.md.

query: Estructura este skill como lo hacemos nosotros: front-matter, body y evals.
expected_behavior: Should structure the target skill per the house canon (read-only canon, writes only the target skill).

query: Audit this skill's description against our trigger-first rule and char budget.
expected_behavior: Should check the description against skill-conventions.md (trigger-first, char budget).

query: ¿Este skill sigue nuestros patrones? Compáralo con nuestras convenciones de skills.
expected_behavior: Should compare the skill against the house conventions and report differences.

query: Bring this skill in line with our conventions — check the marker-block and the evals layout.
expected_behavior: Should apply house conventions to the target skill's own files only.

query: Revisa que este skill cumpla con nuestras convenciones internas y reporta qué falta.
expected_behavior: Should produce a gap report against skill-conventions.md.

query: Validate this skill's structure against our house skill-conventions and list what's off.
expected_behavior: Should validate structure against the canon and list deviations.

query: Aplica nuestras convenciones de skills a este skill que estoy armando y dime los gaps.
expected_behavior: Should apply house conventions to the in-progress skill and report gaps.

query: Create a new skill from scratch that posts release notes to Slack.
expected_behavior: Skill creation from scratch → skill-creator, NOT aidex-skill. Split-boundary precision check (primary sibling).

query: Optimize this skill's description so it triggers more reliably — run the eval and tune it.
expected_behavior: Description optimization + eval running → skill-creator, NOT aidex-skill. Split-boundary precision check (primary sibling).

query: Let's plan the v2 of the dashboard before we touch code. It's a big multi-layer refactor.
expected_behavior: Plan creation → aidex-plan, NOT aidex-skill. Split-boundary precision check.

query: We decided to split the mega-skill into single-purpose skills. Document the decision and why.
expected_behavior: Decision record → aidex-decision, NOT aidex-skill. Split-boundary precision check.

query: El cliente pidió un botón de exportar a PDF en el reporte. Captúralo como request.
expected_behavior: Request capture → aidex-request, NOT aidex-skill.

query: Investiga cómo funciona el sistema de skills de Claude Code antes de proponer nada.
expected_behavior: Research about the skills system → aidex-research, NOT aidex-skill (not a conventions check of a target skill).

query: Documenta cómo funciona nuestro install.sh y los symlinks como referencia.
expected_behavior: Reference doc → aidex-reference, NOT aidex-skill.

query: Track for later: we should add evals to all the skills eventually. No deadline.
expected_behavior: Track-for-later → backlog-register, NOT aidex-skill.

query: Audit my Claude Code ecosystem — unused skills, broken symlinks, bloated MEMORY.md.
expected_behavior: Ecosystem audit → aidex, NOT aidex-skill.

query: This skill isn't triggering at all in a session — help me debug why it never fires.
expected_behavior: Live trigger debugging → skill-creator/debugging, NOT aidex-skill (not a house-conventions check).

query: Create a /ship skill for this project that runs the linter and tests, then drafts a commit message.
expected_behavior: Published built-in phrasing: from-scratch skill CREATION is skill-creator's. aidex-skill checks an existing skill against house conventions.
